focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，最高达38%
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于7月13日公布了对中国产电动汽车的反补贴调查初步裁定，拟加征17%至38%不等的临时关税。该措施预计8月起实施，涉及比亚迪、上汽等多家中国车企。企业需在7月底前提交抗辩意见。建议出口企业立即评估供应链布局，考虑在欧盟设厂或调整出口市场结构以降低风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会官方公报 · 2026.07.14
focus.title_en: EU Imposes Provisional Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs Up to 38%
focus.summary_en: On July 13, the European Commission announced preliminary findings of its anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese electric vehicles, proposing provisional tariffs ranging from 17% to 38%. The measures are expected to take effect in August, affecting BYD, SAIC, and other Chinese automakers. Companies must submit rebuttals by end of July. Exporters are advised to reassess supply chains, consider EU production bases, or diversify export markets to mitigate risks.
focus.source_en: Source: Official Journal of the European Union · 2026.07.14

case.title: ICC仲裁庭裁定：跨境电商平台数据跨境传输条款因违反GDPR而无效
case.summary: 国际商会(ICC)仲裁院近日就一起中国跨境电商与欧盟消费者之间的数据纠纷作出裁决，认定平台要求用户同意数据跨境传输至中国的格式条款因违反GDPR关于充分性保护的要求而无效。仲裁庭强调，企业必须提供不低于欧盟标准的保护措施，否则条款不可执行。该案为中国出海企业合规处理欧盟用户数据提供了重要警示。
case.title_en: ICC Tribunal Invalidates Cross-Border Data Transfer Clause for Violating GDPR
case.summary_en: In a recent award, the ICC International Court of Arbitration ruled that a Chinese cross-border e-commerce platform's standard clause requiring EU users to consent to data transfer to China was invalid due to non-compliance with GDPR adequacy requirements. The tribunal held that companies must provide protection at least equivalent to EU standards. This case serves as a critical warning for Chinese companies handling EU user data.
case.source_en: Source: ICC International Court of Arbitration, Award June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境争议解决新规：允许深圳前海法院直接认可港澳民商事判决
policy.summary: 广东省高级人民法院于7月12日发布《关于深化粤港澳大湾区跨境民商事判决认可与执行的意见》，明确深圳前海合作区人民法院可直接认可和执行香港、澳门法院作出的民商事判决，无需经内地中院层级审查。该意见自2026年8月1日起施行，将大幅缩短跨境执行周期，降低企业维权成本。
policy.source: 来源：广东省高级人民法院 · 2026.07.12
policy.title_en: New GBA Rules: Shenzhen Qianhai Court May Directly Recognize HK and Macau Judgments
policy.summary_en: On July 12, the Guangdong High People's Court issued the 'Opinions on Deepening Recognition and Enforcement of Cross-Border Civil and Commercial Judgments in the Greater Bay Area,' allowing the Qianhai Cooperation Zone People's Court to directly recognize and enforce civil and commercial judgments from Hong Kong and Macau without intermediate court review. Effective August 1, 2026, this will significantly shorten cross-border enforcement timelines and reduce compliance costs.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体设备出口管制升级，企业需建立“供应链合规防火墙”
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部工业安全局(BIS)近期拟扩大对华半导体制造设备出口管制范围，将部分成熟制程设备纳入许可要求。建议中国芯片企业立即开展供应链尽职调查，识别受控物项及最终用户风险；建立内部合规筛查机制，对涉及美国技术或软件的设备采购实施逐单评估；同时考虑通过海外子公司或第三方合作获取非美替代方案。英文：Attorney Qin's view: BIS plans to expand export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, covering some mature-node tools. Chinese chip firms should conduct supply chain due diligence, identify controlled items and end-user risks, establish internal compliance screening for equipment involving US technology, and consider non-US alternatives via overseas subsidiaries or third-party partnerships.
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: US Semiconductor Export Controls Expansion – Build a Supply Chain Compliance Firewall
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: BIS plans to expand export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, covering some mature-node tools. Chinese chip firms should conduct supply chain due diligence, identify controlled items and end-user risks, establish internal compliance screening for equipment involving US technology, and consider non-US alternatives via overseas subsidiaries or third-party partnerships.
